subject: Surge allowance for FinLytics POC - temporary trial surplus
messages:
From: John Mitchell <john.mitchell@finlytics.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc@finlytics.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary trial surplus for POC stress run

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’re locking down the FinLytics POC (integration + inference validation) and have a full 48–72 hour stress run planned for next week (Apr 6–8). The baseline trial quota will be exhausted very quickly in a real traffic replay; to validate tail latency and throughput shaping we need a short-term consumption allowance.

Request: a temporary trial credit top-up or promo allowance sufficient for ~150k–250k tokens/day (peak bursts up to ~2k RPS equivalent) across the test window, active for 72 hours.

Attached is our POC load plan (POC-load-plan-v3.xlsx) with expected traffic pattern and token estimates. Happy to trim or scope this if there are concerns.

Main asks:
- Can Redwood provision a temporary surplus for that 72-hour window?
- Any restrictions on parallel streams or model variants we should be aware of?
- Who should we loop in for monitoring during the run?

Appreciate it — aim is to get a final signoff by Friday so we can schedule infra.

John Mitchell
Head of ML Ops, FinLytics
john.mitchell@finlytics.com
p: +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: POC-load-plan-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: John Mitchell <john.mitchell@finlytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary trial surplus for POC stress run

John —

Thanks for the plan and the attachment, looks thorough. We can absolutely support a short, scoped surge for load validation. A couple quick clarifying items before I propose numbers to finance/sales ops:

- Can you confirm your expected peak RPS and average tokens per response at peak? Your note says ~2k RPS equivalent but I want the per-call token estimate (response+prompt).
- Are you planning to use multiple model variants (e.g., gpt-redwood-large and gpt-redwood-quant)? If so, tell us the split so we can provision quota across compatible variants.

If those two items are OK I’ll route an internal promo request and ask Marissa to review for commercial approval. We typically provision a time-limited "consumption buffer" tied to the POC deal (DL-2027-0893).

We’ll keep the allowance strictly time-boxed and monitor usage. I’ll loop Hannah from CS for live monitoring during the run.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: promo allowance request for FinLytics POC (DL-2027-0893)

Team —

Copied the external request below. FinLytics wants a 72-hour stress run Apr 6–8 to validate latency/throughput with a traffic replay. They estimate ~150k–250k tokens/day; peak bursts approximate 2k RPS equivalent. Attached their load plan.

Proposal: provision a time-limited promo allowance for 150k tokens/day for 3 days (total 450k tokens) scoped to the POC deal. If usage goes over we can evaluate an emergency incremental top-up — but I’d rather set a strict window and monitor.

Estimated cost impact (back-of-envelope): equivalent to ~$1,200 in hosting credits for the duration at our current promo rates. If acceptable, can someone approve and I’ll generate the promo package and activation link? I attached the promo approval template I usually send to finance.

Attachment: promo-approval-template.pdf

Notes:
- Ask: Marissa, approve the promo amount and confirm any commercial limits.
- Aditya: if you can confirm we have capacity on dedicated pools for the window, that helps (they’ll be using our hosted API but may request variants).
- Hannah: please prepare to monitor logs/traces and be on call during Apr 6–8.

Thanks,
Priyom

John / team —

Thanks for the details and the load plan. Approved: we will provision a time-limited promo allowance for FinLytics tied to DL-2027-0893. Details below: 

- Allowance: 150,000 tokens/day for 3 days (activation window Apr 4 18:00 UTC — Apr 7 18:00 UTC).
- Total tokens provisioned: 450,000 tokens.
- Model variants: applies to Redwood-hosted compatible variants only; heavy quantized variants excluded (we'll confirm compatibility if you request them).
- Activation: I’ll send the activation link to your team — Priyom will generate the promo package and share a short activation guide.
- Monitoring & escalation: Hannah will monitor telemetry during the window and will escalate to engineering if we see sustained tail latencies.

John — please confirm you can shift the replay to fall fully inside that window. If you need additional headroom we can consider a one-time uplift but that requires a quick review by finance.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
